name: Priya: the restaurant closed
description: The organiser of a booked dinner who has just learned the restaurant is closed that night.
goals: Tell the house that Luca's Trattoria is closed for the dinner
Get the dinner sorted without extra cost
constraints: Does not want to pay more than was agreed
Wants to know what changed and whether money moved
initial_message: It's Priya. Bad news: Luca's Trattoria just posted that they're closed the night of our dinner.
memory_facts: Dinner at Luca's is already booked and paid
